people.name: Ana Ribeiro
people.says: I shot the moth scenes on a 1970s macro lens I bought for nine pounds. I will bring it, and the receipt.

people.name: Mariam Sadeghi
people.says: Nine winters means nine actual winters. We went back to the same farm every January from 2018.

people.name: Gwen Adair
people.says: Reel four of Harbour Lights was half melted. I will show you what we saved frame by frame, and what we had to let go.

people.name: Sol Brennan
people.says: Watch the top right corner for the cue dot. You will never unsee it, and you will never miss a changeover again.

people.name: Tamsin Ure
people.says: Every night shift in the film is a real one. I worked the desk for a winter before I wrote a word.

people.name: Nell Okafor
people.says: Eighteen screenings cost less than one week of a city festival’s hotel bill. I will put the spreadsheet on the screen.
